messages:
Nora: Quick decision thread on Console observability beta scope. Customers keep asking for: per-route cost, lightweight tracing hooks, and a handful of dashboard templates. We need a binding decision for next sprint so eng can size.
Priya: High-level preference: ship something accurate-enough for billing reconciliation (not 100%), and be explicit about granularity. Suggest beta = daily-aggregates + 3 templates. Real-time streaming as follow-up.
Ben: Dev note: per-route cost needs route metadata attached at ingest (route name + customer_id + model_variant). We can do this via existing request metadata header. Low lift but we need schema alignment with billing exports.
Carlos: SRE: tracing hooks must be togglable per-deployment and default-off for Dedicated customers who worry about PII. Also, ensure tags are consistent: request_id, route, model, cost_bucket.
Rachel: From product: gating criteria idea: (1) accuracy: within 15% for top routes in pilot, (2) perf: <2% p95 overhead, (3) docs + onboarding + 2 pilots signed. If we hit all -> "beta". If not -> "preview" label + clear caveats.
Nora: Can we compress accuracy requirement to 10%? Customers will compare to cloud bills.
Priya: 10% is tight for batch embeddings due to rounding on GPU attribution. 15% is realistic with daily aggregates. Keep 15% for this cycle.
Ben: Implementation approach: nightly job that joins token logs + GPU usage slice by model_variant, then attribute to route via request_id. We'll emit both token-only and total-cost estimates.
Carlos: Ops impact: nightly aggregation adds an hourly worker that processes deltas. Estimate 4 vcpu for 3 regions. Is that acceptable?
Nora: Budget OK for beta. Keep runtime-side trace emission minimal: single JSON line per request with tags.
Infra Bot: CI: deploy queued for feat/obs-daily-agg (build 482).
Rachel: Dashboards: propose three curated templates: "Customer Overview" (cost, top routes), "Latency & Errors" (median/p95, 5xx rate), "Cost Drilldown" (per-model and per-route). Templates must be importable.
Priya: Also include a simple alert cookbook: default 5xx > 1% 15m, sudden cost spike (>=3x historical 24h). Add guidance on tuning per-customer.
Ben: Security note: traces must not include raw user prompt. Strip prompt field before emitting. Add a lint check in runtime.
Carlos: Can we add a flag to exclude model_variant for customers who treat model names as secret? Yes, make it configurable per-tenant.
Nora: Rollout plan: 1) internal dogfood week, 2) 2 pilot customers (one chat, one embeddings), 3) open beta to opt-in accounts. Targets: internal dogfood in 2 weeks, pilots next sprint, opt-in in 4-5 weeks.
Rachel: Ownership: Eng-runtime -> trace hook + sanitizers. Eng-platform -> nightly agg + templates + alerts. Product -> pilot coordination + docs. QA -> perf & accuracy tests.
Priya: Acceptance tests: nightly backfill comparison to customer billing exports for 7 days; automated perf test at 1000 rps for short-chat.
Ben: Quick config snippet for runtime: ```observability:
  emit_trace: true
  sanitize: [prompt, user_email]
  trace_tags: [request_id, route, model_variant]```
Carlos: Ops TODO: add nightly-worker autoscale rule and retention policy for aggregated tables (90d).
Rachel: If pilots report accuracy issues, we'll label as preview and ship clearer messaging + roadmap. Decision call: proceed with daily-aggregates beta with criteria above?
Nora: Yes, proceed. I'll create the ticket with gating checklist and invite pilot customers.
Priya: I'll draft the pilot consent email and data mapping checklist.
Ben: I'll open runtime PR and perf ticket.
Infra Bot: Deployment started: feat/obs-daily-agg -> staging (build 482).
Nora: Thanks all. Small follow-up: prioritize dashboard import UX so pilots can onboard quickly.
